a-fresh-start-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: A Fresh Start saw the return of Tony Stark, Steve Rogers, Logan, Odinson and Bruce Banner to their classic identities of Iron Man, Captain America, Wolverine, Thor and Hulk respectively. The War of the Realms event caps off a seven year run of Thor stories by Jason Aaron. Also Marvel decides to go overboard with all the limited series and one-shots.

eighth-day-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Millennia ago, eight great mystic entities entered into the Wager of the Octessence to determine who among them was the most powerful. Each of them created a totem which held a fraction of their vast power, and would transform the first human who touched into an exemplar, a living embodiment of that power. The entities all then had Temples created to house their totems. Once a mortal became an exemplar, a spell would be triggered, drawing others to the temples, creating eight Exemplars in all.

infinity-crusade-reading-order.text: Goddess, Adam Warlock’s “Good Side”, recruits an army of heroes to fight her holy war. Thanos and Adam Warlock unite to stop her.

infinity-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Thanos has learned that the Avengers have left Earth, leaving it vulnerable, prompting him to prepare to invade Earth.
infinity-reading-order.text: Thanos has learned that the Avengers have left Earth, leaving it vulnerable, prompting him to prepare to invade Earth.

infinity-war-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: When Adam Warlock takes possession of the Infinity Gauntlet, he expels the good and evil aspects of his being to become a totally logical being, who can therefore use the Gauntlet wisely. This act recreates his “evil” persona and old foe the Magus, who desires universal conquest and revenge against Warlock and Thanos.

infinity-wars-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: As the Infinity Stones come to Earth, so too comes the war for control over them. But none who wield the stones know the truth about the power they contain or what it would take to bring them to their end.
infinity-wars-reading-order.text: As the Infinity Stones come to Earth, so too comes the war for control over them. But none who wield the stones know the truth about the power they contain or what it would take to bring them to their end.

inhumanity-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The Terrigen Mists have been released throughout the world and activate dormant Inhuman cells in ordinary people who are Inhumans descendants.
inhumanity-reading-order.text: The Terrigen Mists have been released throughout the world and activate dormant Inhuman cells in ordinary people who are Inhumans descendants.

inhumans-vs-x-men-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The Terrigen Mist that is loose on Earth is reaching its saturation point. While people across the planet have manifested powers and learned of their Inhuman heritage, it’s also resulting in many mutants getting sick and dying. The X-Men are determined to stop the Terrigen Mist in order to avoid extinction while the Inhumans need the Terrigen to ensure the population of their species thrives.

jonathan-hickmans-marvel-2009-2015-readi.text: One of the most truly epic comic book runs in recent history. Enjoy.

king-in-black-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: After a campaign across the galaxy, Knull’s death march arrives to Earth. With an army of hundreds of thousands of symbiote dragons at his command, the King in Black is a force unlike any Earth’s heroes have ever faced.
king-in-black-reading-order.text: After a campaign across the galaxy, Knull’s death march arrives to Earth. With an army of hundreds of thousands of symbiote dragons at his command, the King in Black is a force unlike any Earth’s heroes have ever faced.

kravens-last-hunt-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Kraven hunts down Spider-Man, defeats him, and seemingly shoots him dead. Kraven then buries him, and donning a copy of Spider-Man’s costume, seeks to prove himself superior at his adversary’s former activities.
kravens-last-hunt-reading-order.text: Kraven hunts down Spider-Man, defeats him, and seemingly shoots him dead. Kraven then buries him, and donning a copy of Spider-Man’s costume, seeks to prove himself superior at his adversary’s former activities.

last-annihilation-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Guardians of the Galaxy and S.W.O.R.D. fight Dormammu, Lord of the Dark Dimension, who has merged with Ego the Living Planet and plans to conquer space.
last-annihilation-reading-order.text: Guardians of the Galaxy and S.W.O.R.D. fight Dormammu, Lord of the Dark Dimension, who has merged with Ego the Living Planet and plans to conquer space.

magneto-war-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Magneto has returned and announced to the UN that he’s created another electromagnetic pulse, and that it will not stop until Magneto’s given a mutant sanctuary on Earth.
magneto-war-reading-order.text: Magneto has returned and announced to the UN that he’s created another electromagnetic pulse, and that it will not stop until Magneto’s given a mutant sanctuary on Earth.

marvel-1602-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Marvel 1602 takes place in a timeline where Marvel superheroes exist in the Elizabethan era; faced with the destruction of their world by a mysterious force, the heroes must fight to save their universe.
marvel-1602-reading-order.text: Marvel 1602 takes place in a timeline where Marvel superheroes exist in the Elizabethan era; faced with the destruction of their world by a mysterious force, the heroes must fight to save their universe.

marvel-2099-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Marvel 2099 explores a possible, dystopian future of the Marvel Universe. North America is a corporate police state ruled by a few huge megacorporations, most notably Alchemax, which owns the private police force the Public Eye. There are no active superheroes in the world, and the previous heroes are mythologized through religion, as with the Church of Thor.

marvel-legacy-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock:
A relaunch following the Secret Empire event, Marvel Legacy attempted to bring a greater focus to Marvel's core superheroes. It saw the return of Bruce Banner as Hulk, Tony Stark as Iron Man, and Thor Odinson reclaiming the hammer Mjolnir. Wolverine, Jean Grey, and Franklin and Valeria Richards are all back; while the Thing and Human Torch search for Sue and Reed Richards, who have been missing since Secret Wars.

During Marvel Legacy many series returned to using their legacy numbering.

During Marvel Legacy many series returned to using their legacy numbering.

marvel-zombies-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Marvel Zombies is set in an alternate universe where the world’s superhero population has been infected with a virus which turned them into zombies. The zombie super heroes largely retain their intellect and personality, although they are consistently driven by the “Hunger” for human flesh.
marvel-zombies-reading-order.text: Marvel Zombies is set in an alternate universe where the world’s superhero population has been infected with a virus which turned them into zombies. maximum-carnage-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Since the alien symbiote he was bonded to was destroyed during his capture, Cletus Kasady is presumed powerless and jailed at Ravencroft Asylum. However, the symbiote mutated his blood prior to its destruction, enabling Kasady to generate a copy of the symbiote and break out.

maximum-security-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: A multitude of alien civilizations that have previously interacted with Earth join forces to prevent humans from interfering further with galactic affairs. To accomplish this, they designate Earth as a penal colony.
maximum-security-reading-order.text: A multitude of alien civilizations that have previously interacted with Earth join forces to prevent humans from interfering further with galactic affairs. To accomplish this, they designate Earth as a penal colony.

mc2-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: May “Mayday” Parker is the child of Peter and Mary Jane Parker in a future, alternate universe continuity. Despite her parents’ hopes, May began developing versions of her father’s spider-powers when she was fifteen, donning a Spider-Man costume and taking up crimefighting.

messiah-war-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Cyclops forcibly sends X-Force into the timestream in pursuit of Cable and Hope. X-Force arrives in the year 2973, with 32.5 hours to complete their mission before their time-travel devices accelerate their biology and kill them.
messiah-war-reading-order.text: Cyclops forcibly sends X-Force into the timestream in pursuit of Cable and Hope. X-Force arrives in the year 2973, with 32.5 hours to complete their mission before their time-travel devices accelerate their biology and kill them.

midnight-massacre-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Blade reads a page from the Darkhold, transforming into Switchblade. Now capable of not only killing occult-powered individuals, he absorbs their abilities and powers as well. He begins a mission to find and wipe out all supernatural beings on Earth.

monsters-unleashed-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Monstrous behemoths threaten to destroy various cities and its all hands on deck with the Avengers, Champions, Guardians of the Galaxy, X-Men, and the Inhumans to prevent this monstrous invasion.
monsters-unleashed-reading-order.text: Monstrous behemoths threaten to destroy various cities and its all hands on deck with the Avengers, Champions, Guardians of the Galaxy, X-Men, and the Inhumans to prevent this monstrous invasion.

muir-island-saga-reading-order.text: After warnings from Forge and Banshee, the X-Men and Professor X investigate Muir Island, whose inhabitants have been taken over by the Shadow King.

mutant-massacre-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The Marauders attack the underground mutant community and kill hundreds of Morlocks before the X-Men and X-Factor teams arrive separately and fight them, avoiding the total slaughter of the Morlocks. The two teams however do not meet during the battle and suffer crippling losses.

necrosha-reading-order.text: Selene, the Black Queen of the Hellfire Club, has gained access to the Techno-organic virus, which she uses to resurrect a variety of deceased mutants to set her plans into motion of becoming a goddess.

one-more-day-reading-order.text: After his Aunt May has been shot, Spider-Man seeks help to save her life. He encounters the demon Mephisto, who offers to save her life if Spider-Man gives him his marriage.

one-world-under-doom-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Doctor Doom has declared One World Under Doom, a global initiative offering “order, stability, and protection” to nations destabilized after recent cosmic and supernatural crises. Several smaller states have already accepted Doom’s protection treaties, granting him strategic footholds worldwide.

onslaught-saga-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Following his mind-wipe of Magneto, Xavier’s mind has become infested by the dark part of Magneto’s psyche. Onslaught, a psychic entity of near limitless power, is born from this merger. Onslaught plans to use the raw psionic energy of Franklin Richards to transform the human race into a collective consciousness.

operation-galactic-storm-reading-order.text: The Avengers become involved in a war between the Kree and the Shi’ar empires.

operation-zero-tolerance-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: After the events of Onslaught Saga several individuals within the United States government attempt to use their positions to hunt down all mutants across the country.
operation-zero-tolerance-reading-order.text: After the events of Onslaught Saga several individuals within the United States government attempt to use their positions to hunt down all mutants across the country.

original-sin-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Uatu the Watcher has been murdered. Nick Fury must now lead the Avengers into uncovering the mystery of who killed the Watcher and why. They come into conflict with a group of misled self-appointed investigators led by Black Panther and Punisher.

over-the-edge-reading-order.text: The Punisher has gone insane. He is convinced Nick Fury and S.H.I.E.L.D. were responsible for the death of his family, and is after Fury.

phalanx-covenant-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The X-Men are attacked by the Phalanx, mutant-hating humans who have used the techno-organic virus to turn into techno-organic beings themselves. With these powers, the Phalanx are able to change their shape and assimilate organic matter. As the Phalanx they are a hive mind, programmed to destroy all mutants.

planet-hulk-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The Illuminati decide the Hulk is too dangerous to remain on Earth. They trick him into entering orbit to destroy a rogue satellite, and then use a shuttle to jettison him from the solar system. They intended for him to land on a peaceful planet, but the shuttle passes through a wormhole on its way, crashing on the planet Sakaar.

realm-of-kings-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: When Black Bolt and Vulcan were apparently killed in a massive explosion the great eruption of energy ripped a giant hole in the fabric of space and time, creating what is now known as the “Fault.” While investigating the “The Fault” Quasar is sucked into the reality at the other end, the Realm of Kings.

revolutionary-war-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: A troubling vision in Darkmoor Castle portends the horrible truth: the sinister Mys-Tech organization has returned. The UK’s greatest heroes must come together to face a threat that could destroy the world.

rise-of-the-midnight-sons-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The Midnight Sons were formed by Danny Ketch and Johnny Blaze after Ghost Rider received a vision in which he learned that Lilith, Mother of Demons, was being resurrected and posed a great threat. She planned to use her demon children, the Lilin, to take over Earth.

road-to-vengeance-missing-link-reading-o.originalHtmlBlock: Lilith has regenerated her children inside her, but she needs one of them to help her give birth to them, so she calls out into the world. Outcast answers his mothers call and slashing her open, her previously consumed children are reborn, more powerful than before.

second-clone-saga-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: A clone of Spider-Man, created years ago and thought dead, reappears. Tests reveal that the clone is the real Spider-Man and Peter Parker is only a clone. Several mysterious figures appear, some of them clones. What follows is one of the most bloated comic events of all time.

secret-empire-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Due to the manipulations of the Red Skull, Captain America, secretly a true believer in the cause of Hydra, uses the trust and respect he has gained over the years to attempt a takeover of the Marvel Universe.
secret-empire-reading-order.text: Due to the manipulations of the Red Skull, Captain America, secretly a true believer in the cause of Hydra, uses the trust and respect he has gained over the years to attempt a takeover of the Marvel Universe.

secret-invasion-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: A subversive, long-term invasion of Earth has taken place by the alien Skrulls. Capable of shapeshifting, the Skrulls have secretly replaced many of Marvel’s heroes with impostors over a period of years, prior to an overt invasion.

secret-wars-ii-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The entity that instigated the first Secret Wars, the Beyonder, visits Earth in search of enlightenment and inevitably comes into conflict with Earth’s superhumans and the cosmic entities that exist in the Marvel Universe.
secret-wars-ii-reading-order.text: The entity that instigated the first Secret Wars, the Beyonder, visits Earth in search of enlightenment and inevitably comes into conflict with Earth’s superhumans and the cosmic entities that exist in the Marvel Universe.

shadowland-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Matt Murdock returns to Hell’s Kitchen from Japan as a changed man and seeks to utilize the Hand as a force for justice, including constructing Shadowland, a prison/temple constructed on the ruins of a Hell’s Kitchen building.
shadowland-reading-order.text: Matt Murdock returns to Hell’s Kitchen from Japan as a changed man and seeks to utilize the Hand as a force for justice, including constructing Shadowland, a prison/temple constructed on the ruins of a Hell’s Kitchen building.

shattered-heroes-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The heroes have come through The Serpent’s War with their faith tested and their bodies shattered, weary and tried, but still standing. But they’re going to have to deal with the fallout of the choices they made and the things they had to do in order to succeed and survive.

siege-of-darkness-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The demonic union of Zarathos and Lilith spells supernatural trouble for Earth unless the Midnight Sons can stop the carnage.
siege-of-darkness-reading-order.text: The demonic union of Zarathos and Lilith spells supernatural trouble for Earth unless the Midnight Sons can stop the carnage.

siege-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Asgard, home of the Norse Gods, is floating above Oklahoma and is the last holdout in Norman Osborn’s consolidation of power. After engineering a tragedy Osborn and the Dark Avengers begin an assault on Asgard. Captain America and his own team of Avengers try to stop them.

spider-geddon-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The Inheritors have found a way out of the decimated world they were imprisoned on and are now determined to take their revenge on the Spider-Army and feed on them once again.
spider-geddon-reading-order.text: The Inheritors have found a way out of the decimated world they were imprisoned on and are now determined to take their revenge on the Spider-Army and feed on them once again.

utopia-reading-order.text: After riots in San Francisco, Norman Osborn tries to enforce peace by creating his own team of Dark X-Men to serve in much the same way the Dark Avengers did, and using both of his teams to bring down the real X-Men.

venom-inc-reading-order.text: Spider-Man reluctantly teams up with Venom and the new Anti-Venom, Flash Thompson, to stop former Venom host Lee Price, now known as Maniac, and his Inklings from taking over the New York City criminal empire.

venom-war-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Eddie Brock and his son, Dylan Brock, clash in a brutal battle to decide who becomes the one true Venom. As visions of dystopian futures haunt them both, they rally allies, including Spider‑Man, Black Widow, Wolverine, and Carnage, and wage war across New York.

venomverse-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: In a desperate attempt to survive, Doctor Strange used his magic to transport various venomized heroes from their dimensions to his own. With his new allies from across the Multiverse, a Resistance was created to fight against the Poisons, an alien species capable of assimilating symbiotes and their hosts. The Resistance now struggles to stop the Hive and their onslaught.

war-of-kings-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Vulcan is rapidly expanding the Shi’ar Empire, while Black Bolt and the Inhumans become leaders of the Kree empire, and a cosmic war begins, drawing in Nova, Darkhawk, the Starjammers, and the Guardians of the Galaxy.

war-of-the-realms-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The heroes must band together when Malekith the Accursed leads his forces to invade Midgard, the last realm he has yet to conquer.
war-of-the-realms-reading-order.text: The heroes must band together when Malekith the Accursed leads his forces to invade Midgard, the last realm he has yet to conquer.

wolverine-goes-to-hell-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: “The Red Right Hand” is a group of people who have been wronged by Wolverine and have sworn revenge on him. They trap him in a mystical circle to send him straight to Hell. While he is in Hell, a group of demons possess Wolverine’s body and attack his allies.

world-war-hulk-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: After the Illuminati banished Hulk from Earth, the spacecraft they used explodes and kills Hulk’s pregnant wife. Blaming the Illuminati for her death, Hulk returns to Earth for revenge with his allies, the Warbound.

world-war-hulks-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The Leader and M.O.D.O.K. have unleashed a Cathexis ray upon the heroes, turning them all into Hulked-out versions of themselves. The Leader then reveals that all the Hulked-out-Heroes will soon die, because of the overload of radiation in their bodies.

wraith-war-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: When the Dire Wraiths decide to take control of Earth, Rom and Starshine step up to defeat them, with help of S.H.I.E.L.D. and other super-heroes.

x-cutioners-song-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: An assassination attempt on Professor Charles Xavier seems to the work of Cable, the former leader of X-Force. X-Factor begins hunting down X-Force. Meanwhile Jean Grey and Cyclops are attached by the Horsemen of Apocalypse.

x-men-age-of-revelation-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: X years from today the Revelation Territories stretch from the Atlantic to the Mississippi, a mutant utopia ruled by the heir of Apocalypse. But beneath the surface, rebellion brews. As a ragtag X-Men team strikes from the shadows, Revelation faces threats from within.

x-men-divided-we-stand-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The X-Men are disbanded. A new X-Force team is formed to carry out covert assassinations. Wolverine tracks Mystique to make her pay for her actions in Messiah Complex, while Cable tries to protect the mutant baby from Bishop.

x-men-endangered-species-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: On M-Day the mutant population was reduced to a fraction of what it once was. Beast decides to try to find a way to reverse the effects of M-Day, in the hopes of preventing the extinction of mutantkind.

x-men-manifest-destiny-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The X-Men set up a new headquarters in San Francisco, moving from Xavier’s school in Westchester, and send a telepathic invite to every mutant on Earth.

x-men-messiah-complex-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The first child with the X-gene since M-Day has been born, sparking a race between the X-Men, the Marauders, the Acolytes, the Reavers, the Purifiers, and Predator X to see who will find the child first.

x-men-nation-x-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: The X-Men are settling into their new home on the freshly resurfaced Asteroid M, officially renamed Utopia. They are rebuilding homes, cultivating a farm, keeping their island afloat, rationing food, gathering the Atlanteans, and defending against enemies both old and new ones.

x-men-original-sin-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: When Wolverine joined the X-Men Xavier knew he was sent to kill him but let Wolverine join anyway, wiping his mind clean in the process and making him his own personal weapon. Now Logan asks Xavier to repeat what he did all those years ago. Only this time his target will be Wolverine’s son, Daken.

x-men-regenesis-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: After the events of Schism the X-Men have been split in two, with Cyclops and Wolverine each leading their own faction of heroes.

x-men-schism-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: After Cyclops delivers a speech to the United Nations asking for all Sentinel programmes around the world to be decommissioned, the UN Building is attacked. As a result of the attack several countries begin to mobilize their Sentinels.

x-men-second-coming-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Cable and Hope return from the future to the present. Their arrival sparks off action from Bastion and his allies. Bastion tells them that the Mutant Messiah has returned and gives them orders to kill her.

x-of-swords-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Omniversal Majestrix Saturnyne organizes a mystical tournament in Otherworld between the X-Men and the Swordbearers of Arakko. Immortal mutant Apocalypse and the rest of Krakoa must gather ten swords to the face the invading interdimensional army of Arakko, commanded by the original Four Horsemen.

x-termination-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Billions of years ago, the Celestials created an unimaginable horror and, in realizing their error, locked it away in the space between realities. However, with all the constant travelling between realities by the worlds’ heroes and villains, the barriers between realities have become weak.

x-tinction-agenda-reading-order.originalHtmlBlock: Genoshan Magistrates attack the X-Mansion and kidnap Storm and the New Mutants. It will take the combined might of the X-Men, New Mutants, and X-Factor to try and save them.
